subject: Access forensics and SCIM delta package request
messages:
From: Sara Lee <compliance@fintrust.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@fintrust.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SCIM delta + access justification pack

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. As part of our vendor assessment and SIG questionnaire review, we need three small artifacts to close our IAM controls section: 

- A short sample of SCIM delta logs illustrating user create/disable/change events (timestamped) spanning at least 30 days; CSV or JSON is fine.
- A couple of SSO assertion examples (SAML response snippets with attribute mappings redacted as needed) showing NameID and role/entitlement claims.
- An internal access justification playbook (how Redwood documents least-privilege decisions and role assignments) — a 1–2 page summary will do.

Could you confirm whether you can provide redacted examples and an abbreviated process write-up by EOD Thursday (5/14)? We can accept redactions for PII but need enough detail to validate mapping and role lifecycle.

Appreciate it — Sara
Sara Lee
Vendor Risk Analyst, FinTrust
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <compliance@fintrust.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + access justification pack

Sara —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide redacted SCIM delta samples and SAML assertion snippets; I will also attach a concise playbook that outlines how we manage role assignments, JIT elevation, and periodic entitlement reviews.

Quick notes on scope so we stay aligned:
- The SCIM delta sample will include: event type (create/update/disable), timestamp, source (SCIM connector id), and the affected attribute changes. We will redact user emails but leave role/entitlement labels intact.
- SAML assertions will have unique IDs, NameID formats, and a sample of the role claim; assertions will be safe to share (no raw PII).
- The playbook is intentionally short — process flow, owners, and a template justification for exceptions.

Looping in Naomi and Laura for logs access and to confirm redaction timeline.

Next steps: Naomi will pull the SCIM delta extract and drop it in the shared Drive link; Laura will attach the playbook and SAML snippets. If you need signed attestations or a SOC2 mapping table tied to these artifacts, let us know.

Best,
Marcus
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: access-justification-playbook.pdf (PDF), scim-delta-sample.csv (CSV)
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Sara Lee <compliance@fintrust.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + access justification pack

Hi all —

I pulled a 45-day SCIM delta extract from our provisioning pipeline and redacted email addresses and UUIDs as discussed. Sample includes:
- 2026-03-29T14:22:03Z, CREATE, user.externalId: [redacted], groups: [engineer, analytics]
- 2026-04-01T08:05:21Z, PATCH, user.active: true -> false, reason: termination_workflow
- 2026-04-18T10:11:59Z, UPDATE, groups: [+sales_ops, -contractor]

Files uploaded to Drive: scim-delta-sample.csv (redacted), sso-assertion-examples.txt (redacted). I kept the event payload columns consistent with RFC7644 naming so you can validate against your controls checklist.

A couple of FYIs:
- We removed any IP or host-level metadata (internal switching info).
- If FinTrust prefers JSON rather than CSV, I can re-export.

Laura — can you attach the playbook summary in this thread so Sara can download?

Thanks,
Naomi
Senior Security Operations Engineer

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/fintrust/iam-playbook
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lee <compliance@fintrust.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SCIM delta + access justification pack

Sara —

Attaching a short playbook PDF that describes our access justification flow:
- Role taxonomy and ownership (how roles map to product services)
- Justification template used by hiring/product teams for role grants
- Quarterly entitlement review cadence and exception handling
- How we record permanent escalations and timeboxed elevations in Jira SUP tickets

Also included are two redacted SAML assertion examples (NameID + role claim only) in sso-assertion-examples.txt.

If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-minute call next week to go through the artifacts and point to the SOC2 control mappings — Marcus, Karthik, are you available Wed morning PT?

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: access-justification-playbook.pdf (PDF), sso-assertion-examples.txt (TXT), scim-delta-sample.csv (CSV)
